title: LegalEvolver: Agentic Legal Judgment Prediction via Rubric-Guided Self-Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.06381v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As LLM-based agents develop, they have been increasingly applied in the legal domain. Legal Judgment Prediction~(LJP) requires models to conduct multi-step reasoning and external legal evidence retrieval. Existing legal search agents' performance is often constrained by the quality of retrieval queries. They often formulate queries directly from the initial user request, overlooking latent legal issues and legally salient details. To address this issue, we propose \emph{LegalEvolver}, a query optimization framework specifically designed to generate legally informative queries for LJP-oriented retrieval. Sampling high-quality optimized queries and their corresponding search trajectories is challenging, as relying solely on unguided high-temperature rollouts is both inefficient and constrained by the model's initial capabilities. We therefore heuristically optimize queries as seeds, improving the efficiency of trajectory generation. Furthe

translated_title: LegalEvolver：基于评分准则引导自我进化的智能体法律判决预测
translated_abstract: 随着基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体不断发展，它们已被越来越广泛地应用于法律领域。法律判决预测（LJP）要求模型进行多步推理并检索外部法律证据。现有法律搜索智能体的性能往往受限于检索查询的质量：它们通常直接根据用户的初始请求构建查询，而忽略了潜在的法律问题和具有法律重要性的细节。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 LegalEvolver，一个专为 LJP 导向检索设计的查询优化框架，用于生成具有法律信息量的查询。采样高质量的优化查询及其对应的搜索轨迹极具挑战性，因为仅依赖无引导的高温采样（rollouts）既低效，又受限于模型自身初始能力。因此，我们采用启发式方法将查询优化为种子，从而提升轨迹生成的效率……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出 LegalEvolver 框架，通过评分准则引导的自我进化机制将查询启发式优化为种子，为法律判决预测生成更具法律信息量的检索查询，从而突破现有法律搜索智能体受限于查询质量的性能瓶颈。
en_tdlr: LegalEvolver is a rubric-guided self-evolution framework that heuristically optimizes queries as seeds to generate legally informative retrieval queries for Legal Judgment Prediction, overcoming the query-quality bottleneck of existing legal search agents.
